title: Synthesis and characterisation of bio-derived furan-based polyamides copolymers from dimethyl furan-2,5-dicarboxylate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7581-7589
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09346E, Paper
Open Access

Zoe Paganelli, Lauri Välinen, Onsi Hanafi, Sami-Pekka Hirvonen, Hossein Baniasadi, Jukka Niskanen
Bio-derived polyamides and copolyamides are synthesised utilising a furan-based diacid, effectively tuning their characteristics depending on diamine molar ratio.
